lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pd₄Al₄Sn₄ (reduced formula PdAlSn) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216) with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Al and Sn each have eight Pd neighbors, while Pd has four Al and four Sn neighbors, all at 2.6912 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Al–Sn, Al–Pd, and Sn–Pd 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
